desc:
Alright, so ZUN has confirmed that Ariya's avian aspect is based on the **Archaeopteryx** – iconically the earliest known bird in the world.

An alternative name for this is **Urvogel**, which is literally ***"proto-bird"*** in German, and it's actually translated just like that for the Japanese equivalent – ***shisochou.***

And since the name in Japanese is so simple, the bird actually shows up in school tests a lot. And so in all likelihood, ZUN probably got the image of the bird while reading through his kids' homework or something.
